name: print-social-black-lime-mascot-exchange-instagram-post-set
title: Lime Mascot Exchange Post Set
whatItIs: A black board of three portrait posts featuring a lime character with a spiky head: 'How it works' with a thinking mascot, 'Start exchanging today' with the mascot between pixel arrows, and 'Why choose' with word-chip buttons, plus a designer credit.
whatItMeans: A charming mascot and one neon lime make a dry exchange product feel friendly, and pixel arrows add a digital note.
techniques: One mascot in different poses per post
Neon lime and cream type on black
Faint grid and chart line background

vocabulary.definition: A character that represents the brand across designs.
An arrow made of square pixels.
Words placed in rounded chips that read as a phrase.
